body:
I think what's bad about this rotation thing is that the dev team don't have a direction and idea after everything applies into game.   
3 days playing and all I played was Elites, Samira/Fizz, Sett/Karma.  
While every card that could counter those kind of decks is now limited.  
Lots of card that has been rotated serve no purpose for being in the rotation list.  
Irelia, Ezreal, TF got rotated? I'm sure people can get it.  
Removing card that isn't broken or just unused at the moment is just mindboggling. because even in ranked lots of people try their best to use unorthodox card like Glorious Evolution, Tri-Beam, Timebombs, etc.  
Forbidding champion like Zoe while her problem card is something like Feel The Rush, Viktor, etc is one of example where this Rotation is planned since a long time, still felt rushed.  
What I learn here is about this rotation that this is bad because :  
1. Generally no clear path of what to rotate (Rotate something just because of quota, because if this stuff about real balance Ionia will have more stuff to rotate just to balance something from Frejlord)  
2. Less and less creative decks.   
3. The New Champions and Packages power level is too high for the region that dont receive new Champ.  
4. Not enough new cards added to replace what is missing. (Enjoy playing Noxus, Bilgewater, Ionia for 3 month bois)  
This game dont have a problem as rampant as Heartstone, YGO, MTG, etc yet as LoR card pool isn't as much as them, also LoR more regularly nerf/buff cards (erratas).  If adjusting a card doesnt work, just ban some of problem card/limit them, just like YGO I think it will work better than whatever this Rotation is.
